answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in relic, expire in velvet, and timber lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 38 aliases as a result needs 138 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 117 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
